HuntTargetShootingStrategy - Class in com.batallanaval.ai
"Hunt and finish" strategy: if there is any cell in the HIT state (a damaged ship that isn't sunk yet), it fires at random among the neighboring cells (up/down/left/right) that haven't been fired at yet, to try to sink that ship before exploring further.
